source_description: Historical baseline bundle for Invoice & Receipt Manager (build spec Part H, sections 36-39)
notes: Due dates are derived from the 7-day payment terms in settings.json; the sources do not state them. Recorded as issue DERIVED-DUE-DATE.
The business was not GST registered in this period, so every line is non-taxable and GST is 0.00.
Legacy record 0001-1 / ERROR is deliberately absent from invoices.csv and present only in migration_issues.csv.
